name: Slumberland
source:
Alice lives in a universe where some persons are blessed at birth by Mother Nature with the gift of a special magical power. In fact, all her family was blessed at birth. Alice's father had the power to heal other people (but not himself). Alice's mother can magically find lost people (sadly, the poor woman herself suffers from myopia and is always losing her glasses, which makes her life a bit difficult). For some reason, Alice decided she doesn't want to be a magical girl. On her 15th birthday she plans to say it to her fairy godmother, so her magic will be taken from her and she will become a common girl. But before that, a mysterious boy started to haunt Alice's dreams. Alice was destined to become a magical weaver of dreams, so her godmother suggests that, before renouncing to her magical power, she makes use of it to try to find out who is the mysterious boy in her dreams.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=45&t=24703]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
爱丽丝生活在一个宇宙中，有些人一出生就受到大自然的祝福，拥有特殊的魔法力量。事实上，她的全家一出生就受到了祝福。爱丽丝的父亲有能力治愈其他人（但不能治愈他自己）。爱丽丝的母亲可以神奇地找到走失的人（可悲的是，这位可怜的女人本身患有近视，而且总是丢失眼镜，这让她的生活变得有些困难）。出于某种原因，爱丽丝决定她不想成为魔法少女。她计划在15岁生日那天对她的仙女教母说这句话，这样她的魔法就会被夺走，她将成为一个普通的女孩。但在此之前，一个神秘的男孩开始困扰爱丽丝的梦境。爱丽丝注定要成为一名神奇的梦境编织者，所以她的教母建议她在放弃自己的魔法力量之前，先利用它来找出梦中的神秘男孩是谁。
